title: The Oath of the Sundered Sea
author: Ines Eriksen
blurb: Gideon Thackeray, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
